label: Non-pipelined units
subgoals: Group the operations into rounds of one per unit
Multiply the number of rounds by the latency
Treat occupancy as equal to latency

label: Fully pipelined units
subgoals: Issue one operation per unit per step
Find the step of the last issue
Add the latency minus one to get the completion step

label: Partially pipelined units
subgoals: Read the unit's occupancy and its latency separately
Space issues on each unit by the occupancy
Add the latency to the last issue step
